cohort: Pregnant women with single-fetus pregnancies at > 22 weeks gestation who underwent labor induction at Hospital Universitário of the Universidade Federal de Santa Catarina (HU/UFSC) between 2013 and 2016
finding: Previous cesarean delivery, fetal IUGR, and excessively short or long induction times were associated with cesarean section after labor induction.
mod_finding: The study investigated factors associated with cesarean section after labor induction, highlighting a 34.3% cesarean rate in induced labors and a 44.3% rate in cases of induction failure.
